metadata.disclaimer: 20 manually written examples provide preliminary evidence of model generalization, not statistically conclusive validation.

test_cases.title: Dropdown menu cut off inside responsive modal wrapper on mobile viewports
test_cases.description: When resizing screen below 600px width, selecting options in filter menu gets hidden behind container boundary. Needs z-index adjustment and overflow visible on parent modal overlay.
test_cases.notes: Classic responsive layout clipping bug.

test_cases.title: Dark mode toggle fails to persist preference across page refresh
test_cases.description: User switches theme switch in top bar, but on reload it reverts back to light theme. LocalStorage key is not read during initial component layout mount.
test_cases.notes: Frontend component state persistence defect.

test_cases.title: Deadlock during concurrent bulk update of user subscription records
test_cases.description: Parallel background jobs attempting to lock target rows in customer table cause SQL state 40001 under heavy read-write load. Need transaction isolation level review and index tuning.
test_cases.notes: Relational database transaction locking deadlock.

test_cases.title: PostgreSQL connection pool drops idle connections without recycling
test_cases.description: HikariCP pool holds stale connections when database restarts, causing application queries to fail with Broken Pipe error until application restarted.
test_cases.notes: Database connection pooling and lifecycle issue.

test_cases.title: Session token remains valid after user requests full logout
test_cases.description: JWT revocation endpoint returns success, but previously issued token can still be used to invoke protected endpoints because server-side blacklist isn't checked in gateway filter.
test_cases.notes: Token invalidation security flaw.

test_cases.title: OAuth2 redirect URI validation bypass via double slash in callback path
test_cases.description: Attacker can supply an external redirect location by manipulating trailing slashes in authorization URL, bypassing domain restriction check.
test_cases.notes: Open redirect authorization security defect.

test_cases.title: JSON deserialization throws unexpected null pointer on missing metadata payload
test_cases.description: Sending a POST payload without optional client_info field causes 500 internal server error instead of default fallback handling in OrderProcessingController.
test_cases.notes: Backend API request body parsing error.

test_cases.title: REST endpoint returns incorrect HTTP 200 status code on partial resource creation failure
test_cases.description: When secondary item processing fails inside batch endpoint, response body shows error list but HTTP status code remains 200 OK instead of 207 Multi-Status or 400.
test_cases.notes: API protocol response status code contract mismatch.

test_cases.title: Unclosed file handles during daily export cause JVM native heap exhaustion
test_cases.description: ZipOutputStream is opened inside iteration loop without try-with-resources. Over time, file descriptor count increases until process crashes with OutOfMemoryError.
test_cases.notes: Resource leak leading to process memory exhaustion.

test_cases.title: High CPU spike and garbage collection pauses during large PDF rendering
test_cases.description: Generating monthly reports with high image density triggers excessive temporary object allocations, leading to full GC pauses exceeding 12 seconds.
test_cases.notes: Memory allocation churn and GC pause bottleneck.

test_cases.title: Upstream ingress proxy drops requests with TLS handshake timeout under high latency
test_cases.description: Inter-service calls between API Gateway and Payment Service fail intermittently during peak traffic, logging SocketTimeoutException after 5000ms.
test_cases.notes: Network socket timeout across service proxy.

test_cases.title: gRPC client fails to resolve Kubernetes service DNS name after pod migration
test_cases.description: Channel connection sticks to old pod IP address after deployment rollout, raising UnknownHostException until DNS cache expires.
test_cases.notes: Network resolution failure following container migration.

test_cases.title: GitHub Actions workflow fails at container publishing step due to missing credentials
test_cases.description: Pull request build from fork fails during image upload because AWS ECR authorization secret is omitted in non-main branch pipeline scope.
test_cases.notes: CI/CD deployment pipeline secret missing.

test_cases.title: Maven build fails due to transient dependency version mismatch in release candidate
test_cases.description: Running mvn clean package on fresh environment pulls incompatible guava transitive dependency, failing compilation.
test_cases.notes: Build system dependency resolution failure.

test_cases.title: Custom AST parser crashes on nested macro declarations with generic type parameters
test_cases.description: Extensible type checker fails with ClassCastException when analyzing multi-level nested template definitions in user code editor.
test_cases.notes: Abstract syntax tree type analyzer crash.

test_cases.title: Lexer fails to tokenize raw string literals containing unescaped backslashes
test_cases.description: Syntax highlighting and code analyzer report parse error on valid multiline string blocks with file path content.
test_cases.notes: Lexical analyzer string tokenization error.

test_cases.title: Third-party analytics script fails to record consent banner choices
test_cases.description: Cookie consent preferences are not synchronized with marketing analytics SDK on initial lander.
test_cases.notes: Third-party analytics integration defect.

test_cases.title: Localization string missing for key app.settings.notifications.email_digest
test_cases.description: Spanish translation bundle shows raw key string on settings page for email preference option.
test_cases.notes: Internationalization / translation asset missing.

test_cases.title: Database migration script consumes excessive RAM and crashes worker pod during index creation
test_cases.description: Running alembic migration to add gin index on audit log table causes postgres background worker memory usage to balloon until Linux OOM killer terminates node.
test_cases.notes: DB index operation causing memory exhaustion; expected primary target: Database.

test_cases.title: CORS preflight request rejected by gateway during cross-origin token refresh
test_cases.description: Browser blocks post request from frontend app to auth server because OPTIONS preflight lacks Access-Control-Allow-Headers header.
test_cases.notes: CORS preflight header protocol failure during auth call; expected primary target: Network/HTTP.
